Headquarters: Remote Eastern Canada | Remote Eastern United States

BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

BeyondTrust is looking for a Senior Director of Engineering to lead one of our core enterprise security product portfolios. You will own engineering for the portfolio end to end: technical direction, delivery, quality, and the people and leaders who make it happen.

Our products protect privileged access for enterprises around the world and are deployed on-premises, as appliances, and as SaaS. We are looking for a leader who can serve a demanding enterprise customer base today while moving the portfolio forward on modern cloud architecture and AI-driven engineering.

This is a senior, high-autonomy role. You will be expected to set direction, make and own significant technical and business decisions, and represent engineering with executives, product leadership, and customers.

What You’ll Do

Lead the Portfolio:

• Set the engineering strategy and technical vision for a portfolio of enterprise security products

• Guide cloud architecture for the portfolio's SaaS offerings on AWS, with security, reliability, and scale built in

• Balance investment across deployment models so every customer segment is well served

• Partner with peer engineering leaders on shared services and common architecture

Make Engineering AI-Native:

• Lead the adoption of AI-assisted and agentic development across the organization, from design and coding through testing and release

• Set the standards, tooling, and expectations that make AI a normal part of how teams work, and measure the impact

• Bring AI into quality engineering and operational workflows, not just code generation

Deliver with Quality:

• Own release quality and predictability across all deployment models

• Champion modern quality engineering: test automation, continuous testing, and quality built into the pipeline

• Ensure reliable, secure delivery of releases and updates to customers

• Partner with Support and customer-facing teams on sustaining engineering and high-impact customer issues

Build Security into Delivery:

• Own engineering's side of vulnerability response, from triage through fix to timely patch delivery

• Partner with the security organization on threat modeling, secure code review, and security testing, and make sure findings turn into fixes

• Treat security as a core product quality, held to the same standard as reliability and performance

Build the Organization:

• Lead a multi-team organization of software engineers, quality engineers, and managers through directors and senior managers

• Hire, develop, and retain a strong leadership bench

• Establish planning and execution rhythms that give the business clear visibility into progress and risk

• Own the engineering budget, headcount plan, and vendor and tooling decisions for the portfolio

Partner Across the Business:

• Serve as the primary engineering counterpart to Product Management, owning feasibility and cost on roadmap commitments

• Communicate clearly and proactively with executive leadership

What You’ll Bring

• 12+ years in software engineering, with 5+ years leading multi-team organizations through managers and directors

• A track record of delivering enterprise software with a large installed base, ideally spanning on-premises and SaaS

• A background in secure software development: you have built and shipped security-sensitive software, worked closely with security teams on threat modeling, secure code review, and security testing, and led engineering's side of vulnerability response through fix and patch

• Strong AWS fluency: you have led engineering for products running on AWS and can engage credibly on architecture, security, and cost

• Hands-on conviction about AI in software engineering: you use AI tools yourself and have led their adoption across teams with measurable results

• Experience with modern SaaS engineering practice: multi-tenant architecture, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability

• Experience leading quality engineering toward automation and continuous testing

• Sound financial and vendor judgment, including build-vs-buy decisions and budget ownership

• Excellent written and verbal communication with executives, peers, and customers

Nice To Have

• Identity or privileged access management domain experience

• Experience leading teams building enterprise applications on .NET (C#)

• Experience with regulated cloud environments (FedRAMP, StateRAMP, or similar)

• Experience delivering AI-powered product capabilities

• Experience leading distributed teams across countries and time zones

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience; Master's a plus

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.

Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com. 

#LI-BS1

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/beyondtrust-sr-director-engineering

About Kirana Club
India has over 12 million kirana stores, and most still depend on traditional wholesale markets to source products for their shops.

Kirana Club is changing how these retailers discover, source, and replenish inventory. With 4 million+ kiranas on the platform, we're building a commerce marketplace that connects retailers directly with brands and sellers.

Now part of the Meesho family, we're entering our next phase of growth, with an opportunity to rethink how B2B commerce and fulfilment work at scale.

About the role
We're looking for someone who enjoys solving complex business problems, is exceptionally comfortable with numbers, and can turn ideas into real-world outcomes.

You'll work on some of the most important medium-term initiatives in our fulfilment and supply chain business — projects that can fundamentally improve our cost structure, delivery experience, and ability to serve retailers across India.

This is a high-ownership individual contributor role, not a traditional operations management position.

What you'll work on
• 3PL allocation and optimization: Rethink how orders get allocated across logistics partners to improve delivery success, speed, and cost per delivered order.

• New fulfilment models: Experiment with initiatives like retailer self-pickup, alternative delivery networks, and new ways of reducing logistics costs.

• Supply chain economics: Analyze shipping costs, RTOs, delivery performance, and operational data to identify opportunities for meaningful improvements.

• 0-to-1 experiments: Take new ideas from hypothesis to pilot, evaluate results, and build a plan for scaling what works.

• Cross-functional execution: Work closely with Product, Tech, Analytics, Operations, and external partners to translate solutions into live implementations.

The problems will evolve as the business scales. You'll be expected to adapt, learn quickly, and take ownership of new challenges.

What we're looking for
• Strong analytical and quantitative skills. You should be able to break down problems, work with data, and make sound decisions.

• Structured, first-principles problem solving, especially when information is incomplete.

• Excellent prioritization: knowing what matters, what can wait, and how to get to an answer quickly.

• High ownership and bias for action. You don't just recommend solutions; you make them happen.

• Ability to independently drive projects involving multiple teams and stakeholders.

• Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where problems are not always clearly defined.

• Experience in business strategy, analytics, program management, or strategic operations. Experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, or logistics is a plus.

Why this role
You'll get to work on problems where a single successful initiative can materially change the economics of the business.

This is an opportunity to build new fulfilment models, solve problems at scale, and work closely with the leadership team on initiatives that directly shape Kirana Club's growth.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Join an elite team of highly skilled Systems Support Engineers and Sales Engineers, to play a key role in the company’s post sale technical assistance and customer experience. • Hands on experience with Mac OS X, Windows & Linux administration and troubleshooting

• Experience working with Single Sign On (SSO) environments

• Experience setting up and configuring Active Directory

• Excellent command of Linux Shell and PowerShell

• In depth knowledge of prem/cloud/hybrid environments

• Fluent in English and Spanish, in both written and verbal communication

• Working knowledge of Python

Preferred Requirements

• Experience working with and troubleshooting identity access management solutions, including PAM (privileged access management)

• Ability to adapt, overcome objections, and learn complex solutions

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
• 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
• 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
• 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work
• 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
• 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
• 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
• 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
• 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer
• 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
• 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
• 
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
• 
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
• 
Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún
• 
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
About the role
ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and share. The team is small, agent-first and sits apart from the main org, with very fast CI, so ideas often ship the same or next day. Today, one engineer runs the whole iOS app alone.
We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer to own ElevenMusic across iOS and Android, and to make mobile a driver of the product rather than a downstream port of web features. You’ll build for musicians and creatives, think in systems as well as screens, and work with high autonomy and a high bar for taste.
Requirements
• 
Shipped a well-designed, production mobile app that real users love, and can show us what you owned.
• 
Strong systems thinking across mobile and backend. We’re framework-agnostic (Swift UI or Kotlin Jetpack Compose), but expect you to work across iOS and Android.
• 
Exceptional product taste and a clear view on what makes a mobile experience great.
• 
Highly self-directed: you turn loose directions into shipped work and own the outcome.
• 
Comfortable with the backend API layer as you'll need to be able to use Python, even if your speciality is in Mobile
Bonus: musical interest or intuition. Open-source or GitHub contributions.
Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Warsaw, and Amsterdam.
#LI-Remote
We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
